g.text: The quantifier boundary — Theorem IRG.3 and Exercise IRG.3
Fix the actual affine core first; then allow every matrix deletion.
A finite physical test set obstructs constant multiplicity.
BF may choose a different ordinary tunnel after seeing the targets.
The general BF and fixed-WM endpoint questions remain open.
